working.entered_source:
10 N=0:S=1
20 PRINT CHR$(11):PRINT "TURN";N
30 INPUT A$
35 IF A$="Q" THEN END
40 GOSUB 1000
50 GOTO 20
1000 C=0
1010 IF A$<>"GO" THEN RETURN
1020 N=N+S
1030 IF N>255 THEN N=N-256
1040 C=1
1050 RETURN
RUN
